changes.summary: Require every canonical catalog capability to have an explicit knowledge route, source eval contexts from a closed registry, and reserve exact legacy Fee V2 context for its one matching case.
Add an optional hard-bounded brief Project Compiler view that preserves the full report identity, result and evidence boundary while omitting exhaustive arrays.
Materialize bounded nested Solidity source and test trees as one inert source-bound Foundry plan without candidate execution, network, deployment, approval, or launch authority.

Trigger on explicit Programmable requests or clear intent to design, build, repair, review, test, upgrade, or submit a complete Uniswap v4 hook or project while excluding explanations, unrelated Solidity work, skill discovery, and non-blockchain use.

Bind cold context by digest and activate at most one route-owned specialist per distinct confirmed capability, up to two references total, while preserving split-review holds and the frozen Fee V2 quarantine.
Run the portable Builder and installed-package verification on Node.js 22 or newer while retaining the complete repository, Foundry, and release gate on pinned Node.js 24.
Add a hash-bound non-completion repair-attempt contract and bounded read-only diagnosis path without weakening the all-pass completion receipt or trusting the portable signer.
Bind structured Builder responses and exact reference-activation receipts into repository E2E evidence and add a lean daily trigger sentinel.
